name: Owner payment never settles tenant operational dues without joint-liability opt-in
title: SC-09-02-03 Owner payment never settles tenant operational dues without joint-liability opt-in
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a unit has an unpaid tenant operational due and an unpaid owner capital due
When the property owner makes an undesignated payment
Then the owner capital due is settled and the tenant operational due is untouched
